items.cn: 记忆提取在十九世纪晚期成为心理学术语；信息检索在二十世纪中期成为一个领域名称。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): the Vulgar Latin verb behind trouver is a reconstruction, the path from Greek tropos is a hypothesis, and no exact first citation is recorded for the noun.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：trouver 背后的俗拉丁动词属重构形式，从希腊 tropos 来的路径属假说；名词没有确切的最早书证。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same French verb of finding again; group two holds nouns of getting something back.
note.cn: 第一组是同出法语「重新找到」这一动词的词形；第二组是表示「取回」的近义名词。

entries.definition: The verb for getting something back; the noun names the act as a thing that can be timed and measured.
entries.definitionCN: 指取回的动词；名词把该动作当作可计时、可测量之事。

entries.definition: An adjective for what can still be recovered; it describes a possibility, not an operation.
entries.definitionCN: 指仍可被取回的形容词；描述可能性，而非操作。

entries.definition: A dog bred to fetch game, or a person who recovers things; it names the agent, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 指被培育来捡回猎物的犬，或负责找回物件的人；指施事者，而非动作。

entries.definition: From re- plus a Latin verb meaning 'to draw', so it means drawing back; the sound is close but the root is trahere, not trouver.
entries.definitionCN: 由表「返回」的前缀加一个意为「拉」的拉丁动词构成，意为后撤；读音相近，但词根是「拉」，不是「找到」。

entries.definition: The act of getting something back or returning to health; it is broader and often implies restoring a state.
entries.definitionCN: 指取回某物或恢复健康的行为；更宽泛，常含「恢复原状」之意。

entries.definition: Bringing something back to mind or summoning it back; it is the mental side, while retrieval also covers stores and files.
entries.definitionCN: 指把某物带回意识或叫回；偏心理一侧，而 retrieval 还包括仓库与文件。

entries.definition: The act of drawing something out of where it is fixed, as a tooth or data from a file; it stresses removal, not return.
entries.definitionCN: 指把固定在某处的东西拔出，如牙齿或文件中的数据；强调取出，而非返回。

entries.definition: The everyday verb for going and bringing something back; retrieval is its formal noun, used for systems and memories.
entries.definitionCN: 指去把某物拿回来的日常动词；retrieval 是它正式的名词形式，多用于系统与记忆。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: A prefix of 'again' on a verb of finding: to find again what had been lost.
normal.cn: 表「再次」的前缀加表「找到」的动词：把失去的东西再找回来。

normal.en: The family runs retrieve, retrievable, retriever and irretrievable, all from one French verb.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 retrieve、retrievable、retriever、irretrievable，全出同一个法语动词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: information retrieval, memory retrieval, data retrieval, beyond retrieval.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：信息检索、记忆提取、数据检索、无法挽回。

normal.en: Memory is treated as a well: something is lowered in, and later drawn up.
normal.cn: 记忆被当作一口井：东西放下去，之后再提上来。

normal.en: The noun is the act, the agent is the dog: a retriever does the retrieval.
normal.cn: 名词是动作，施事者是狗：寻回犬做的就是 retrieval。

abstract.en: Picture a bucket on a rope coming up out of dark water with a box inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一只系绳的桶从黑水里上来，桶底有只盒子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand reaching into the deepest shelf for a book long overdue.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸进最深的一格书架，抽出那本久借未还的书。

abstract.en: Picture a rope thrown to two climbers on a ledge.
abstract.cn: 想象一根绳子抛向岩台上的两名登山者。

examples.en: Retrieval of the file failed because the index was corrupt.
examples.cn: 取回该文件失败，因为索引已经损坏。

examples.en: Each retrieval from memory alters what is stored.
examples.cn: 每一次从记忆中提取都会改变所存的内容。

examples.en: The archive charges a fee for retrieval from the closed stacks.
examples.cn: 该档案馆对从闭架书库取书收取费用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「再次」+「找到」——再找回来：从井里、从书架、从记忆、从磁盘，都是同一次提拉。

root: 古法语 retrouver「重新找到」= 表「再次」的前缀 + trouver「找到」；trouver 上溯一个俗拉丁动词（属重构形式），通常再追溯到希腊 tropos「转向」，该路径属假说。英语 retrieval 由动词加名词词尾构成。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: something is drawn back out. Out of a well it is a box; out of memory an item; out of a collection a document; out of a database a record; out of a broken disk a file; out of closed stacks a book; out of danger a climber; and out of disgrace a reputation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：把某物重新提出来。从井里提出的是盒子，从记忆里提出的是条目，从文献集合里提出的是文档，从数据库里提出的是记录，从损坏的磁盘里提出的是文件，从闭架书库提出的是书，从危险中提出的是登山者，从耻辱中提出的是名声。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bucket on a rope rising out of dark water, and a hand pulling a long-overdue book from the deepest shelf.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只系绳的桶从黑水里升起，一只手从最深的一格书架抽出久借未还的书。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL AND THE URGENT: a dropped box hauled up, and climbers roped off a ledge.
branches.cn: 实物与急难：被拉上来的落水盒子，与用绳索救离岩台的登山者。

branches.en: THE MIND'S STORE: an item located and brought into awareness, sometimes failing at the tip of the tongue.
branches.cn: 心里的仓库：被定位并带入意识的条目，有时就卡在「话到嘴边」。

branches.en: TWO INDEXED STORES: documents ranked for a query, and records fetched by a key.
branches.cn: 两种带索引的仓库：为查询排序的文献，与按键值取回的记录。

branches.en: THE BROKEN DISK: files recovered after deletion or failure.
branches.cn: 损坏的磁盘：在删除或故障之后被恢复的文件。

branches.en: OUT OF THE STACKS, OUT OF DISGRACE: a book fetched by slip, and a reputation got back by years of work.
branches.cn: 出书库、出耻辱：凭条取出的书，与靠多年工作挽回的名声。

intro.en: Retrieval is a French verb of finding again, with two prefixes and a noun suffix around one root of finding.
intro.cn: retrieval 是一个表「重新找到」的法语动词的后代，围绕一个表「找到」的词根，带两个前缀与一个名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The verb's second element, trouver, is not Latin in form; it goes back to a reconstructed Vulgar Latin verb and, by a hypothesis, to Greek tropos. Latin re- supplies the prefix.
latinIntro.cn: 这个动词的第二个成分 trouver 在形式上不属拉丁语；它上溯一个重构的俗拉丁动词，并按一种假说上溯希腊 tropos。拉丁语只提供了表「再次」的前缀。

items.example: The prefix adds the second attempt.
The verb named the finding, not the search.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指「找到」，而非「寻找」。

items.example: The compound named recovering what had been lost.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词指把失去之物找回来。

items.example: The dog retrieved the stick from the pond.
items.exampleCN: 狗从池塘里把木棍捡回来。

items.example: Retrieval from the archive needs a pass.
items.exampleCN: 从档案馆取件需要通行证。

items.example: The deleted mail is still retrievable.
items.exampleCN: 已删除的邮件仍可取回。

items.example: The retriever waited at the water's edge.

definition_en: to make something known or visible that was hidden
core_image: 一块幕布被拉开，后面的景象突然出现在眼前
scene: 调查揭示了一个令人震惊的事实。The investigation revealed a shocking fact.
sceneCN: 这里 reveal 是「揭示」（第 1 个义项：让原本隐藏的事情为人所知）；句意：调查揭示了一个令人震惊的事实。

collocations.zh: 一个能说明问题的细节

senses.title: Make known
senses.definition: to make a fact or secret known
senses.definitionCN: 使事实或秘密为人所知
senses.example: The report revealed serious problems.
senses.exampleCN: 报告揭示了严重问题。
senses.why: The Latin source means to draw back a veil, so revealing uncovers what was hidden.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源意为拉开面纱，因此 reveal 就是揭开被遮住的东西。

senses.title: Make visible
senses.definition: to show something that was not visible before
senses.definitionCN: 使之前看不见的东西显示出来
senses.example: The curtain rose and revealed a bright stage.
senses.exampleCN: 幕布升起，露出明亮的舞台。
senses.why: Pulling away a cover makes the hidden scene visible.
senses.whyCN: 拉开遮盖物，就使隐藏的景象可见。

senses.title: A divine disclosure
senses.definition: to make a religious truth known
senses.definitionCN: 使宗教真理为人所知
senses.example: The prophet revealed a message to the people.
senses.exampleCN: 先知向人们启示了一条信息。
senses.why: Religious language uses the veil image for truths made known by God.
senses.whyCN: 宗教语言用揭幕的意象，表示由神显明的真理。

intro.en: Reveal comes from Latin revelare, to draw back a veil, from velum, a veil.
intro.cn: reveal 源自拉丁语 revelare（拉开面纱），来自 velum（面纱）。

items.en: Velum means a veil or curtain.
items.cn: velum 意为面纱或帘子。

items.en: Revelare means to draw back a veil.
items.cn: revelare 意为拉开面纱。

items.en: Reveler means to disclose.
items.cn: reveler 意为揭露。

items.en: Reveal covers facts and hidden scenes.
items.cn: reveal 涵盖事实与隐藏景象。

items.en: Revelation also names sudden understanding.
items.cn: revelation 也指突然的领悟。

note.en: Reveal is close to disclose and uncover, with the image of a lifted veil.
note.cn: reveal 与披露、揭开相近，带有拉起面纱的意象。

entries.definition: to remove a cover from something
to show something hidden or wrong

normalIntro.en: Reveal is pulling back a veil: the hidden face appears.
normalIntro.cn: reveal 就是拉开面纱：隐藏的面孔显露出来。

normal.en: Reveal the truth means show what really happened.
normal.cn: reveal the truth 意为说明真实发生的事。

normal.en: Reveal a secret means tell what was hidden.
normal.cn: reveal a secret 意为说出隐藏的秘密。

normal.en: Reveal itself means become visible by itself.
normal.cn: reveal itself 意为自行显现。

normal.en: A revealing detail shows more than expected.
normal.cn: a revealing detail 显露出超出预期的信息。

normal.en: Compare disclose: disclose is formal and factual, reveal often has a dramatic image.
normal.cn: 对比 disclose：disclose 正式而平实，reveal 常带戏剧性意象。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain pulled aside on a lit stage.
abstract.cn: 想象幕布在灯光明亮的舞台前被拉开。

abstract.en: Imagine a fog lifting from a mountain.
abstract.cn: 想象雾气从山上散开。

abstract.en: Think of a letter opened after many years.
abstract.cn: 想象多年后拆开的一封信。

examples.en: The letter revealed a family secret.
examples.cn: 这封信揭示了一个家庭秘密。

examples.en: The clouds parted and revealed the moon.
examples.cn: 云层散开，露出了月亮。

examples.en: Tests revealed a small problem in the engine.
examples.cn: 检测显示发动机有一个小问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（去掉）＋ veal（面纱）」——把面纱拿掉，真相就露出来；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回、去）＋ velum（面纱）→ revelare（拉开面纱）→ reveal，核心义「揭开遮盖、使隐藏之物显现」。

sensesIntro.en: Reveal first makes a fact known, then makes something visible, and in religious use means a truth disclosed by God.
sensesIntro.cn: reveal 先指让事实为人所知，再指使事物可见，在宗教用法中指神所显明的真理。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a curtain drawn back to show a hidden scene.
core.cn: 核心意象：幕布被拉开，露出隐藏景象。

branches.en: Making facts known is the main sense.
branches.cn: 让事实为人所知是主要义项。

branches.en: Making something visible is the physical image.
branches.cn: 使事物可见是具体的意象。

branches.en: Religious truth is revealed from above.
branches.cn: 宗教真理是从上而来的启示。

branches.en: Pulling back the cover shows both scene and truth.
branches.cn: 拉开遮盖既露出景象，也露出真相。

branches.en: A revelation can be ordinary or sacred.
branches.cn: 启示可以是普通的，也可以是神圣的。

intro.en: Reveal is re- plus Latin velum, a veil.
intro.cn: reveal 是 re- 加拉丁语 velum（面纱）。

latinIntro.en: Revelare means to draw back a veil.
latinIntro.cn: revelare 意为拉开面纱。

items.example: Re- marks drawing the veil back.
Old French reveler carries the word.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 reveler 传递了该词。
revealing 描述能说明问题的细节。

definition_zh: 揭露；启示；惊人发现；真相的揭示；披露；顿悟
definition_en: a fact or truth made known, especially one that was hidden and comes as a surprise
core_image: 一块蒙布从雕像上滑落，原本藏在布下的裂纹与镀金在灯下同时露出来。
scene: 档案馆员掀开盖在旧地图上的布，观众这才看到地图背面还有一整幅手绘的海岸线。When the cloth was lifted, the hidden coastline on the back of the map came as a revelation.
sceneCN: 这里 revelation 是“被揭开而显露的事实”（第 1 个义项）；句意：布被掀开后，隐藏的图画才显露出来。

pos.zh: 揭露；启示；惊人发现；披露

senses.title: A hidden fact made known
senses.titleCN: 揭露：原本藏着的事实被公开
senses.definition: a surprising fact that has been hidden and is now made known
senses.definitionCN: 原本隐藏、如今被公开的令人意外的事实
senses.example: The letters contained a revelation about the company's early funding.
senses.exampleCN: 这些信件揭露了该公司早期资金来源的一段内情。
senses.why: Revelation comes from revelare, to un-veil; what is revealed was covered, and the noun names both the lifting and the thing uncovered.
senses.whyCN: revelation 出自 revelare“揭开面纱”；被揭示之物原本被盖着，这个名词既指揭开动作，也指揭开后的东西。

senses.title: Truth given from above
senses.titleCN: 启示：被认为来自神明的真理
senses.definition: in religion, a truth disclosed by a divine source rather than discovered by human reason
senses.definitionCN: 宗教中由神圣来源而非人的理性所发现的真理
senses.example: The prophet described his vision as a revelation.
senses.exampleCN: 这位先知把自己的异象描述为一次启示。
senses.why: The veil here is lifted by a power outside the human mind; revelation is knowledge one could not have reasoned to.
senses.whyCN: 这里掀开面纱的是人心之外的力量；启示是人靠推理得不到的知识。

senses.title: The act of unveiling
senses.titleCN: 揭示行为：把遮盖拿掉这一动作
senses.definition: the act of making something known that was previously concealed
senses.definitionCN: 使原本隐蔽之事为人所知的行为
senses.example: The revelation of the documents changed the course of the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 文件的披露改变了审判的走向。
senses.why: The noun can name the event rather than the content, so a revelation may be a moment in time as well as a fact.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词可以命名事件而非内容，因此一次揭露既是一个时间点，也可以是一个事实。

senses.title: A sudden understanding
senses.titleCN: 顿悟：心里忽然亮起来的一刻
senses.definition: a sudden moment of understanding that changes how one sees something
senses.definitionCN: 忽然理解、并改变看法的时刻
senses.example: It came as a revelation that the two problems were the same problem.
senses.exampleCN: 两个问题原来是同一个问题，这让人恍然大悟。
senses.why: What was hidden is inside the person rather than behind a cloth; the veil is ignorance, and it drops all at once.
senses.whyCN: 被藏住的东西在人心里而不是布后；面纱是无知，而它一下子落下。

senses.title: The twist in a story
senses.titleCN: 真相揭示：叙事中揭开的关键信息
senses.definition: the moment in a story when information is disclosed that reinterprets what came before
senses.definitionCN: 故事中披露关键信息、使先前内容被重新理解的时刻
senses.example: The final revelation makes the narrator's earlier silence meaningful.
senses.exampleCN: 最后的真相揭示让叙述者先前的沉默有了意义。
senses.why: A plot works by controlled concealment; revelation is the planned release of what the story was holding back.
senses.whyCN: 情节靠有控制的隐瞒运作；真相揭示就是故事一直扣着的信息被按计划放出。

senses.title: A scandal brought to light
senses.titleCN: 曝光：把丑闻摊到公众面前
senses.definition: the public exposure of wrongdoing that had been kept secret
senses.definitionCN: 把被秘而不宣的不当行为公开曝光
senses.example: The revelations about the factory led to an inquiry.
senses.exampleCN: 有关这家工厂的曝光引发了调查。
senses.why: Public revelation adds an audience: the fact was known to some, and the wrong lies in its having been kept from the rest.
senses.whyCN: 公开揭露加上了受众：事实本为一些人所知，过错在于把它瞒住了其他人。

senses.title: Formal disclosure of information
senses.titleCN: 披露：按程序把信息交由有关方面
senses.definition: the formal release of information to a court, regulator, or the public
senses.definitionCN: 按程序把信息交给法院、监管机构或公众
senses.example: The revelation of the financial records was ordered by the court.
senses.exampleCN: 法院下令披露这些财务记录。
senses.why: Institutions use the word for the lawful lifting of confidentiality, where timing and scope are prescribed.
senses.whyCN: 机构用这个词指合法解除保密，其时机与范围都有规定。

senses.title: Something that opens the eyes
senses.titleCN: 启示性体验：让人重新看世界的事物
senses.definition: an experience or work that changes one's perception of life or art
senses.definitionCN: 改变人对生活或艺术看法的体验或作品
senses.example: Hearing the cellist play was a revelation to the young composer.
senses.exampleCN: 听那位大提琴家演奏，对年轻作曲家来说是一次启示。
senses.why: The word can praise an encounter rather than report a fact; what is unveiled is a new way of seeing.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以赞美一次相遇，而不只是报告一个事实；被揭开的是新的观看方式。

intro.en: Revelation is reveal plus -ation. Reveal comes from Latin revelare, literally to un-veil, from re- as the opposite of, and velare, to cover, from velum, a veil.
intro.cn: revelation 由 reveal 加 -ation 构成。reveal 出自拉丁语 revelare，字面即“揭开面纱”，由表示相反义的 re- 与 velare“遮盖”组成，后者源自 velum“面纱”。

items.en: Velum meant a veil, a sail, or a cloth hung to conceal. The physical cloth is the base of the whole family.
items.cn: velum 意为面纱、帆或用于遮挡的布。这块实物的布是整个词族的基础。

items.en: Velare meant to cover with a veil, and so to hide from view.
items.cn: velare 意为用面纱覆盖，因而指遮住视线。

items.en: Revelare joined re-, here meaning the opposite of the action, with velare: to remove the veil, hence to disclose.
items.cn: revelare 把表示“相反动作”的 re- 与 velare 组合：去掉面纱，因而指揭露。

items.en: Old French reveler carried the sense of disclosing or making manifest, often in religious contexts.
items.cn: 古法语 reveler 带有“披露、使显明”的意思，常用于宗教语境。

items.en: English reveal covers showing what is hidden, whether by a person, a document, or an event.
items.cn: 英语 reveal 涵盖把隐藏之物显示出来，无论施动者是人、文件还是事件。

items.en: The Latin suffix -ationem names the action or its result, so revelation is both the unveiling and the thing unveiled.
items.cn: 拉丁后缀 -ationem 命名动作或其结果，因此 revelation 既是揭开的动作，也是被揭开之物。

note.en: The first group is the reveal family, separated by word class; the second compares words for disclosure, insight, and sacred truth.
note.cn: 第一组是 reveal 词族，按词类区分；第二组比较表示披露、洞见与神圣真理的词。

entries.definition: to make something hidden visible or known. It names the action.
entries.definitionCN: 使隐藏之物可见或为人所知；命名的是动作。
具有揭示重要内容作用的。

entries.definition: having been made known, as in revealed truth.
entries.definitionCN: 已被揭示的，如“启示的真理”。

entries.definition: the release of information, especially formally or legally. It stresses procedure rather than surprise.
entries.definitionCN: 信息的公开，尤指正式或依法进行；强调程序，而非意外。

entries.definition: a deep and accurate understanding of something. It stresses the mental grasp, not the source.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物的深刻准确理解；强调心智把握，而非来源。

entries.definition: a sudden flash of understanding, often with a sense of significance.
entries.definitionCN: 忽然闪现的理解，常带重大意义感。

entries.definition: the act of bringing wrongdoing to public notice, or being subjected to something harmful.
entries.definitionCN: 把不当行为公之于众，或使人遭受有害影响。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: re- plus veil plus -ation. Reveal is literally to un-veil, and the noun adds the result suffix.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：re- 加 veil 再加 -ation。reveal 字面就是“揭开面纱”，名词再加上结果后缀。

normal.en: Re plus veil plus ation: the cloth comes off, and what it hid is now a fact you must deal with.
normal.cn: re 加 veil 加 ation：布被拿掉，布下的东西成了必须面对的事实。

normal.en: A revelation arrives with the sound of a cover being pulled away.
normal.cn: 一次揭露到来时，像一块盖布被拉开的声音。

normal.en: Divine revelation is a veil lifted from the other side.
normal.cn: 神的启示，是从另一侧掀开的面纱。

normal.en: The plot's final revelation makes the first chapter read differently.
normal.cn: 情节最后的真相揭示，让第一章读起来完全不同。

normal.en: A great concert can be a revelation to a young composer.
normal.cn: 一场伟大的音乐会，对年轻作曲家可能是一次启示。

abstract.en: Nothing can be revealed without something having first been concealed.
abstract.cn: 若没有先被隐藏，就谈不上被揭示。

abstract.en: Revelation redistributes knowledge, and knowledge is power, so every unveiling changes a balance.
abstract.cn: 揭露重新分配知识，而知识即权力，因此每次揭开都改变一处平衡。

abstract.en: The most unsettling revelations are the ones that were always in front of us.
abstract.cn: 最令人不安的揭露，往往是那些一直摆在眼前的东西。

examples.en: The diary's revelation that he had known all along changed every earlier judgement.
examples.cn: 日记揭露他其实一直知情，这改变了此前所有的判断。

examples.en: The report's revelations about safety checks forced the plant to close.
examples.cn: 报告对安全检查的揭露迫使工厂关闭。

examples.en: For the students, the microscope was a revelation: the pond water was full of life.
examples.cn: 对学生来说，显微镜是一次启示：池水里满是生命。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（去掉）+ vel（面纱）——把面纱去掉，真相就露出来了。

root: 由 reveal（揭示、显露）加 -ation（名词后缀）构成；reveal 出自拉丁语 revelare“揭开面纱”，由表示相反义的 re- 与 velare“遮盖”组成，后者源自 velum“面纱”，本义为“揭开遮盖后显露出来的事实或动作”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of revelation, all circling one idea: a covering is removed. What was covered may be a fact, a divine truth, a concealed document, one's own ignorance, a plot secret, a scandal, confidential records, or a way of seeing the world.
sensesIntro.cn: revelation 的八个义项都围绕一个观念：遮盖被取下。被盖住的可以是事实、神圣真理、被隐藏的文件、自己的无知、情节秘密、丑闻、机密记录，或一种看世界的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloth sliding off a statue, cracks and gilding appearing together under the lamp.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块布从雕像上滑落，裂纹与镀金在灯下同时露出来。

chain: REVELATION THE UNVEILING AND WHAT IS UNVEILED

branches.en: THE FACT AND THE ACT: a hidden truth made public, and the moment of making it public.
branches.cn: 事实与动作：被公开的隐藏真相，以及公开它的那个时刻。

branches.en: THE VEIL LIFTED FROM ABOVE: truth received rather than reasoned out.
branches.cn: 面纱由上方掀开：被接受而非被推理得出的真理。

branches.en: THE VEIL INSIDE: an inner ignorance that suddenly drops, and an encounter that changes perception.
branches.cn: 内侧的面纱：忽然落下的内在无知，以及改变感知的一次相遇。

branches.en: THE PLANNED RELEASE: a story's withheld information delivered at the chosen moment.
branches.cn: 有计划的释放：故事扣住的信息在选定时刻交付。

branches.en: PUBLIC AND FORMAL EXPOSURE: a scandal brought into the open and records released under order.
branches.cn: 公开与正式披露：丑闻被摊开，记录依命令交出。

intro.en: Revelation is reveal plus -ation. The family includes revelatory and unrevealed, with -atory marking what serves to reveal and un- marking what stays hidden.
intro.cn: revelation 由 reveal 加 -ation 构成。词族包括 revelatory 与 unrevealed，其中 -atory 标记有助于揭示之物，un- 标记仍被隐藏者。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layers are velum, velare, and revelare. The prefix re- here does not mean again but the undoing of the action.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁层次是 velum、velare 与 revelare。这里的前缀 re- 不表示“再一次”，而表示动作的撤销。

items.example: The Latin word also gives English veil and velum in anatomy.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词也给出英语 veil（面纱）以及解剖学中的 velum（软腭）。

items.example: The verb described covering a statue before a festival.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词可描述节庆前把雕像遮起来。

items.example: The scan revealed a crack beneath the paint.
items.exampleCN: 扫描显示颜料下面有一道裂缝。

items.meaning: the unveiling, or the thing unveiled
items.example: The letters were a revelation to the biographer.
items.exampleCN: 这些信件对传记作者来说是一个重大发现。

items.example: The interview was revelatory about his early years.
items.exampleCN: 这次访谈对他早年的经历很有揭示性。

items.example: Revealed preferences differ from what people say they want.
items.exampleCN: 显示出来的偏好与人们口头上说的并不相同。

items.example: The cause of the fire remains unrevealed.
The minutes are revealing about how the vote was arranged.
items.exampleCN: 会议记录透露了投票是如何安排的。

items.meaning: a cloth worn or hung to conceal
items.example: She lifted her veil at the altar.

definition_en: money that a business or government receives
core_image: 钱币像水流一样汇入一个大池子
scene: 新产品的收入超过了公司的预期。Revenue from the new product exceeded the company's expectations.
sceneCN: 这里 revenue 是「收入」（第 1 个义项：企业或政府收到的钱）；句意：新产品的收入超过了公司的预期。

senses.title: Money received
senses.definition: the money that a company receives from its activities
senses.definitionCN: 公司从其活动中收到的钱
senses.example: The company reported strong revenue this year.
senses.exampleCN: 公司报告今年收入强劲。
senses.why: The Latin source means to come back, and revenue is money coming in.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源意为回来，而收入就是流进来的钱。

senses.title: Government income
senses.definition: the money a government collects from taxes
senses.definitionCN: 政府通过税收征收的钱
senses.example: Tax revenue pays for public schools.
senses.exampleCN: 税收为公立学校提供资金。
senses.why: Public income also flows back into the state's hands.
senses.whyCN: 公共收入同样流回国家手中。

senses.title: Total business income
senses.definition: the total amount a business earns before costs
senses.definitionCN: 企业在扣除成本前获得的总金额
senses.example: Annual revenue reached ten million.
senses.exampleCN: 年营业额达到一千万。
senses.why: The whole inflow of a business is its revenue, distinct from profit.
senses.whyCN: 企业全部流入的金额就是营业额，与利润不同。

intro.en: Revenue comes from Latin revenire, to come back, through French revenue.
intro.cn: revenue 经法语 revenue 源自拉丁语 revenire（回来）。

items.en: Venire means to come.
items.cn: venire 意为来。

items.en: Revenire means to come back.
items.cn: revenire 意为回来。

items.en: Revenue means income that returns.
items.cn: revenue 意为返回的收入。

items.en: Revenue means money received.
items.cn: revenue 意为收到的钱。

items.en: It covers company income and tax receipts.
items.cn: 它涵盖公司收入与税收。

note.en: Revenue is close to income and earnings, but is often total inflow.
note.cn: revenue 与收入、收益相近，但常指总流入。

entries.definition: money received from work or investments

normalIntro.en: Revenue is money coming back in: the pool fills from many streams.
normalIntro.cn: revenue 是回流进来的钱：许多小溪汇入大池。

normal.en: Tax revenue is the money a government collects.
normal.cn: tax revenue 是政府征收的钱。

normal.en: Annual revenue is the income of one year.
normal.cn: annual revenue 是一年的收入。

normal.en: Revenue growth means income is increasing.
normal.cn: revenue growth 意为收入增长。

normal.en: A source of revenue is where money comes from.
normal.cn: a source of revenue 是钱从哪来。

normal.en: Compare profit: revenue is all money coming in, profit is what remains after costs.
normal.cn: 对比 profit：revenue 是全部流入，profit 是扣除成本后的剩余。

abstract.en: Picture coins flowing into a large basin.
abstract.cn: 想象硬币流入一个大水池。

abstract.en: Imagine many small streams feeding a river.
abstract.cn: 想象许多小溪汇成一条河。

abstract.en: Think of an open door where money keeps arriving.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇不断有钱进来的门。

examples.en: Tax revenue rose last year.
examples.cn: 去年税收上升了。

examples.en: Advertising is the magazine's main source of revenue.
examples.cn: 广告是这本杂志的主要收入来源。

examples.en: The firm's revenue doubled in five years.
examples.cn: 这家公司的收入在五年内翻了一倍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ venue（来）」——不断回到口袋里来的钱，就是收入；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ venire（来）→ revenire（回来）→ 法语 revenue → revenue，核心义「流回来、进入手中的钱」。

sensesIntro.en: Revenue first means money received by a business, then tax income for a government, and then total business income before costs.
sensesIntro.cn: revenue 先指企业收到的钱，再指政府税收，最后指企业扣除成本前的总营业额。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: coins flowing into a large basin.
core.cn: 核心意象：硬币流入一个大池子。

branches.en: Business income is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 企业收入是日常义项。

branches.en: Government tax income is public revenue.
branches.cn: 政府税收是公共收入。

branches.en: Total inflow before costs is turnover.
branches.cn: 扣除成本前的总流入是营业额。

branches.en: Both companies and states depend on incoming money.
branches.cn: 企业与国家都依赖流入的钱。

branches.en: Revenue measures size, not profit.
branches.cn: revenue 衡量规模，而不是利润。

intro.en: Revenue is re- plus Latin venire, to come.
intro.cn: revenue 是 re- 加拉丁语 venire（来）。

latinIntro.en: Revenire means to come back; revenue is the money that returns.
latinIntro.cn: revenire 意为回来；revenue 就是回来的钱。

items.example: French revenue gives the English word.
items.exampleCN: 法语 revenue 给出英语词形。
revenued 描述有收入的机构。

definition_en: to change something to its opposite direction or order
core_image: 一条白色箭头在灰色地面上突然掉头，指向来路
scene: 他倒车时，发现灰色的小路尽头忽然出现了一片湖。While he reversed the car, he found that a lake had suddenly appeared at the end of the gray lane.
sceneCN: 这里 reverse 是「倒车、使车辆后退」（第 1 个义项：向后移动）；句意：他倒车时，发现灰色的小路尽头忽然出现了一片湖。

senses.title: Going backwards
senses.definition: to move backwards or make a vehicle move backwards
senses.definitionCN: 向后移动，或使车辆向后行驶
senses.example: She reversed the car out of the driveway.
senses.exampleCN: 她把车倒出了车道。
senses.why: The prefix re- marks a backward movement.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 re- 标记向后的运动。

senses.title: Opposite order
senses.definition: to change the order of things to the opposite
senses.definitionCN: 把事情顺序改为相反
senses.example: Please reverse the order of the two names.
senses.exampleCN: 请把这两个名字的顺序颠倒过来。
senses.why: Turning back can also mean turning a sequence around.
senses.whyCN: 转回去也可以指把顺序转过来。

senses.title: Complete change
senses.definition: to change a decision or situation to the opposite
senses.definitionCN: 把决定或局势改为相反
senses.example: The court reversed its earlier ruling.
senses.exampleCN: 法院推翻了先前的裁决。
senses.why: A decision can be turned back, just like a car.
senses.whyCN: 决定也能像车一样被掉转。

intro.en: Reverse comes from Latin revertere, to turn back, through Old French revers.
intro.cn: reverse 经法语 revers，源自拉丁语 revertere（转回）。

items.en: Revertere joins re-, back, and vertere, to turn.
items.cn: revertere 由 re-（回）与 vertere（转）组成。

items.en: Reversus is the past participle, meaning turned back.
items.cn: reversus 是过去分词，意为转回的。

items.en: Old French revers describes something turned the other way.
items.cn: 古法语 revers 描述转向另一边的事物。

items.en: Reverse enters English as both verb and noun.
items.cn: reverse 以动词和名词两种形式进入英语。

items.en: It comes to mean the opposite side or opposite order.
items.cn: 它逐渐指反面或相反的顺序。

note.en: Reverse turns back, while invert turns over.
note.cn: reverse 是转回去，invert 是翻转过来。

entries.definition: to return to a former state

normalIntro.en: Reverse is an arrow that turns around and points back.
normalIntro.cn: reverse 就是掉头、指回来的箭头。

normal.en: Reverse the car means drive it backward.
normal.cn: reverse the car 意为把车倒着开。

normal.en: In reverse order means from last to first.
normal.cn: in reverse order 意为从最后到最前。

normal.en: Reverse a decision means cancel and change it.
normal.cn: reverse a decision 意为撤销并改变决定。

normal.en: The reverse side is the back of something.
normal.cn: the reverse side 是某物的背面。

normal.en: Compare invert: invert flips over, reverse turns back.
normal.cn: 对比 invert：invert 是翻过来，reverse 是转回去。

abstract.en: Picture a one-way arrow pointing backwards.
abstract.cn: 想象一个指向后方的单向箭头。

abstract.en: Imagine reading a sentence from the last word to the first.
abstract.cn: 想象从最后一个词读到第一个词。

abstract.en: Think of a film playing in reverse.
abstract.cn: 想象电影倒着播放。

examples.en: She reversed the car into the garage.
examples.cn: 她把车倒进车库。

examples.en: The court reversed the earlier ruling.
examples.cn: 法院推翻了先前的裁决。

examples.en: The names are listed in reverse order.
examples.cn: 名字按相反顺序排列。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ verse（转）」——转回去，就是反向、颠倒；这只是拆词联想，与 verse（诗句）无关。

root: 拉丁语 revertere（转回）＝ re-（回）＋ vertere（转）→ 法语 revers → reverse，核心义「转回去、反过来」。

sensesIntro.en: Reverse starts with physical turning back, then moves to opposite order, and finally to changing a decision.
sensesIntro.cn: reverse 从身体上的转回开始，再引申为相反顺序，最后指改变决定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white arrow turning back on gray ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：灰色地面上的白色箭头掉头转向。

branches.en: Going backwards is the physical core.
branches.cn: 向后移动是物理层面的核心。

branches.en: Order can be turned around as well.
branches.cn: 顺序也能被调转。

branches.en: A decision can be reversed like a direction.
branches.cn: 决定可以像方向一样被推翻。

branches.en: The same turning motion applies to sequences.
branches.cn: 同样的转向也适用于顺序。

branches.en: Both order and decisions move to the opposite.
branches.cn: 顺序和决定都转向相反的一端。

intro.en: Reverse joins the prefix re-, back, to the Latin root vers, to turn.
intro.cn: reverse 由表示「回」的前缀 re- 与拉丁词根 vers（转）组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere, to turn, lies at the heart of the word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere（转）是这个词语的核心。

items.example: Reversible describes what can turn back.
items.exampleCN: reversible 描述可以反向的事物。

latinEntries.example: Vertere is the root of many English words.
latinEntries.exampleCN: vertere 是许多英语单词的词根。
revertere 在 vertere 前加 re-。

definition_en: to look at something again in order to judge or learn
core_image: 台灯下摊开的笔记，旁边放着一支红笔
scene: 考试前夜，她坐在台灯下复习整学期的笔记。Before the exam, she sat under a lamp and reviewed the notes from the whole term.
sceneCN: 这里 review 是「复习」（第 2 个义项：为学习而重看）；句意：考试前夜，她坐在台灯下复习整学期的笔记。

senses.title: Looking again
senses.definition: to examine something again
senses.definitionCN: 再次检查某事物
senses.example: The committee will review the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会将审查这项计划。
senses.why: Re- means again, so review is to look again.
senses.whyCN: re- 意为再一次，所以 review 就是再看一遍。

senses.title: Studying again
senses.definition: to study material again before a test
senses.definitionCN: 考试前再次学习材料
senses.example: She reviewed her notes before the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前她复习了笔记。
senses.why: Looking again turns into study when a test is near.
senses.whyCN: 临近考试时，重看就变成了复习。

senses.title: Judging a work
senses.definition: to write an opinion about a book, film or play
senses.definitionCN: 对书、电影或戏剧写出看法
senses.example: He reviews films for a local paper.
senses.exampleCN: 他为当地报纸写影评。
senses.why: A review looks again and then judges.
senses.whyCN: 评论是先重看再评判。

intro.en: Review comes from French reveue, a viewing again, from revoir, to see again.
intro.cn: review 源自法语 reveue（再看一次），来自 revoir（再看）。

items.en: Reveue means a viewing again.
items.cn: reveue 意为再看一次。

items.en: Revoir joins re- to voir, to see.
items.cn: revoir 由 re- 与 voir（看）组成。

items.en: Videre, to see, is the deeper root.
items.cn: 拉丁语 videre（看）是更深的词根。

items.en: Review enters English as a look back at something.
items.cn: review 以「回看某物」之意进入英语。

items.en: It also means judging a book or film.
items.cn: 它也指评判一本书或一部电影。

note.en: Review looks again, while revise changes what is seen.
note.cn: review 是再看一遍，revise 是修改所看的内容。

entries.definition: to judge the value of something

normalIntro.en: Review is a second look with a purpose.
normalIntro.cn: review 是有目的的第二次观看。

normal.en: A book review gives an opinion about a book.
normal.cn: book review 是对一本书给出看法。

normal.en: Under review means being examined.
normal.cn: under review 意为正在被审查。

normal.en: Review notes means study them again.
normal.cn: review notes 意为再学一遍笔记。

normal.en: An annual review looks back at the year.
normal.cn: annual review 回顾这一年。

normal.en: Compare preview: preview looks before, review looks again.
normal.cn: 对比 preview：preview 提前看，review 再看一遍。

abstract.en: Picture a red pen moving over old notes.
abstract.cn: 想象红笔在旧笔记上移动。

abstract.en: Imagine a film critic watching a movie twice.
abstract.cn: 想象影评人把一部电影看两遍。

abstract.en: Think of a mirror that lets you see yesterday again.
abstract.cn: 想象一面能让你再看一遍昨天的镜子。

examples.en: The teacher reviewed the lesson with us.
examples.cn: 老师和我们一起回顾了这堂课。

examples.en: Her review of the novel was very kind.
examples.cn: 她对这部小说的评论非常友善。

examples.en: The case is still under review.
examples.cn: 这个案件仍在审查中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）＋ view（看）」——再看一遍，就是回顾、复习、评论。

root: 法语 revoir（再看）＝ re-（再）＋ voir（看），源自拉丁语 videre（看）→ review，核心义「再看一遍并作出判断」。

sensesIntro.en: Review means to look again, whether at a plan, at notes, or at a work of art.
sensesIntro.cn: review 指再看一遍，无论对象是计划、笔记还是艺术作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: old notes under a lamp and a red pen.
core.cn: 核心意象：台灯下的旧笔记与红笔。

branches.en: Looking again is the core act.
branches.cn: 再看一遍是核心行为。

branches.en: Study repeats the look before a test.
branches.cn: 复习是在考试前重复这一看。

branches.en: Judging follows the second look.
branches.cn: 评判紧随第二次观看。

branches.en: Both checking and studying begin with looking again.
branches.cn: 审查与复习都从再看一遍开始。

branches.en: A review looks back and then gives an opinion.
branches.cn: 评论先回看，再给出看法。

intro.en: Review combines re-, again, with the Latin root vid, to see.
intro.cn: review 由 re-（再）与拉丁词根 vid（看）组成。

latinIntro.en: The path runs from Latin videre to French voir and then English review.
latinIntro.cn: 这条路径从拉丁语 videre 到法语 voir，再到英语 review。

items.example: Vid appears in video and evident.
items.exampleCN: vid 出现在 video 与 evident 中。

items.example: Revoir brings the word into French.

latinEntries.example: Videre underlies many words about sight.
latinEntries.exampleCN: videre 是许多与视觉有关单词的基础。
